text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...A new wind...! Filling me up, a 
whirlwind and an auspicious breeze—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Like shoots bursting through the earth, is 
this resilient strength welling up from 
within me...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—The true wind of the Goddesses. Fufu, 
then I shall surrender myself and follow 
wherever the wind blows.
